## IPublishSarifReviewOptions.submit property

Create the review already submitted, as a comment review (GitHub's`COMMENT` event), instead of leaving a draft. Omitted or `false` leaves a draft. It never approves or requests changes, and nothing is inferred from finding severity. Every readiness check and approval hold applies unchanged. The mode is part of the publication identity: a state path is always retried with the mode it started with.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly submit?: boolean | undefined;
```
